record.field: select a.aufnr,a.auart, d.matnr, pt.priokx, qm.qmtxt,d.bdmng from aufk a left join afih b on a.mandt = b.mandt and a.aufnr = b.aufnr left join resb d on a.mandt = d.mandt and a.aufnr = d.aufnr left join makt e on d.mandt = e.mandt and e.matnr = d.matnr inner join mseg f on a.mandt = f.mandt and a.aufnr = f.aufnr left join qmel qm on a.mandt = qm.mandt and a.aufnr = qm.aufnr join t356_t pt on pt.mandt = b.mandt and pt.priok = b.priok and pt.spras = 'E' and pt.artpr = 'PM' where f.bwart = 'Z61'
